The rate of diffusion of three gases, ammonia, carbon dioxide and methane, is measured.
What is the order of the rate of diffusion of the gases from slowest to fastest?
CO2→  NH3→  CH4
A
CO2→  CH4→  NH3
B
CH4→  NH3→  CO2
C
NH3→  CH4→  CO2
D
subject: Chemistry
